# Sari Hills Bali — pool guesthouse near Uluwatu and Nusa Dua

> Sari Hills Bali is a five-room boutique guesthouse with an infinity pool in Kutuh, South Kuta (Kuta Selatan), on Bali's Bukit Peninsula, between Nusa Dua and Uluwatu. Book directly with the owners on Telegram or WhatsApp.

Website: https://sarihills.com/

## Booking

- Telegram booking bot: https://t.me/SariHillsBookingBot
- WhatsApp: +62 817 70859 996 (https://wa.me/6281770859996)
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Sari+Hills+Bali/@-8.8219867,115.1852096,17z
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sarihillsbali/

## Direct booking rates

All rates are per room for up to two guests and include all taxes and charges. No minimum stay is required.

- Nightly rate: IDR 500,000 per night
- Weekly rate, 7 nights or more: IDR 450,000 per night
- Monthly rate: IDR 11,000,000 per month

## Guest information

- Check-in and check-out: check-in is from 2:00 pm, and check-out is by 11:00 am. Self check-in is available for late arrivals, with instructions provided before the stay.
- Reservations and deposit: a deposit of 50% of the total booking amount is required to confirm a reservation.
- Cancellation policy: the deposit is fully refundable for cancellations more than 30 days before the scheduled check-in date. For cancellations made 30 days or less before check-in, the deposit is non-refundable.
- Payment methods: bank transfer or QRIS.
- Room occupancy: each room accommodates up to two adults.
- Children and baby cots: children are welcome. A baby cot is available free of charge. Extra beds are not available.
- Pets are not allowed.
- Kitchen and breakfast: breakfast is not provided. Guests are welcome to use the fully equipped shared kitchen to prepare their own meals.
- Airport transfers and scooter hire: the owners can assist with arranging both. Contact them for details and pricing.

## Rooms

- Five private rooms, each with a double bed and a private ensuite bathroom (walk-in rain shower, hairdryer).
- Every room has air conditioning, a 42-inch smart TV with Netflix, a desk and chairs, an in-room safe and a view of the pool.

## Amenities

- Large infinity pool shared by guests, with sun loungers, a hammock chair and a shaded patio
- Fully equipped shared kitchen in a covered outdoor pavilion
- Free, fast WiFi powered by Starlink
- Free private on-site parking
- Electric vehicle (EV) charging
- Luggage storage before check-in and after check-out

## Location

Sari Hills, Jl. Gubug Sari No.127, Kutuh, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361 (-8.8219867, 115.1852096).

- Pandawa Beach: about 5 minutes' drive (2.8 km)
- Melasti Beach: about 10 minutes' drive
- Nusa Dua: about 15 minutes' drive
- Uluwatu Temple: about 20 minutes' drive
- Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS): about 20 minutes' drive
- Oasis Padel: 4 minutes away
- Nearby beach clubs: Savaya, El Kabron, Single Fin, Sundays Beach Club

## Guest reviews

More than 200 positive guest reviews. Guests often mention that the place is new, spotless and peaceful, the hosts are kind and responsive, the WiFi is fast and the pool area is beautiful.
